info.title: cast
info.description: Scaffolds initial PlantUML sequence diagrams from command-line participants and messages.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: cast — scaffold initial PlantUML sequence diagrams from the command line.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Scaffold a PlantUML sequence diagram from participants and messages.

options.name: --participant
options.description: A participant as '[kind:]alias[:Display Name]'. Repeatable. Run 'cast kinds' to list kinds.

options.name: --message
options.description: A message as 'Source -> Target : label'. Repeatable.

options.name: --autonumber
options.description: Emit 'autonumber' so PlantUML numbers each message. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the diagram to this file instead of standard output.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --no-sample
options.description: When no --message is supplied, do not generate a placeholder flow. [default: False]

commands.name: kinds
commands.description: List the participant kinds usable as the 'kind:' prefix in --participant.

commands.name: ng
commands.description: Diagram how Angular injects dependencies into any inject()-using construct (service, component, function, …).

options.name: --service
options.description: Path to the Angular .ts file to inspect (service, component, directive, pipe, interceptor, guard, resolver, or function).

options.name: --title
options.description: Diagram title (defaults to a generated 'How Angular injects … into <Name>').

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the diagram to this file (defaults to the source path with a .puml extension, e.g. foo.service.ts -> foo.service.puml).

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Write the diagram to standard output instead of a file (takes precedence over --output). [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]
